name: Ootsuka Ayaka
source:
She is the protagonist’s college professor and looks every bit the career woman. She always wears a stern expression and is feared by her students.

As for the protagonist, who is taking her class, their relationship is limited to simply recognizing each other’s faces.

She is married, but her sex life with her husband is lackluster, leaving her somewhat sexually frustrated.

To heighten the sense of taboo in her encounters with the protagonist, she demands that he ejaculate inside her every time. 

"I can't risk getting pregnant, but if it happens I'll have sex with my husband that same night, too," she says.

She regularly initiates sex with the protagonist, and views herself as a slutty wife. Her ability to flip a switch is part of her charm.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/227185/]Getchu[/url]]
